To me, quantitative research brings together fields I've always been passionate about: statistics, probability, financial mathematics, and computational systems.</p><h2>My Own Quant Desk.</h2><p>I believe we're living through a particularly interesting time for independent financial research. Large language models, AI agents, and open-source tools now allow individuals to design, automate, and maintain systems that would have required considerably larger teams and resources just a few years ago.</p><p>I'm currently building my own Quant Desk: an infrastructure for collecting, organizing, and validating market data, researching strategies, evaluating scenarios, and supporting investment decisions. One of the components I'm working on is its data layer, which I consider essential for building reliable models on top of it.</p><p>My goal isn't to build a perfect system from day one, but to develop an infrastructure that can continuously improve, learn from experiments, and bring research closer to real-world results.</p></div></section></main><footer class="site-footer"><div><span class="footer-name">Adrián Vázquez.</span><p class="micro">Research, projects and notes in progress.</p></div><span class="footer-symbol">∴</span></footer></div><script src="../assets/site.js"></script>
